title: Output tracking: an application for irrational SISO transfer functions and a survey for MIMO systems
summary: In this paper we consider (MIMO) finite dimensional linear and time-invariant systems and irrational single-input single-output (SISO) transfer functions. In both cases our aim is to describe as best as possible the range of the input-output map $u(\cdot) \mapsto y(\cdot)$. The theory in finite dimension is quite satisfying but rather scarce, the first aim of this paper is to collect the main results in this direction in a comprehensive way.
